_comment: Research parameters. Values marked as placeholders are NOT research decisions; confirm them before collecting data. Changing the baseline creates a new baseline crosshair row; earlier sessions keep the crosshair they used.

crosshair_units._comment: 1 crosshair unit is rendered as px_per_unit physical (device) pixels. Placeholder: whether units should scale with display resolution is a research decision.

protocol._comment: Experiment protocol (app/experiment/protocol.py). Every session stores a snapshot; protocol_version = label + hash of that snapshot. PLACEHOLDER: practice counts, seeds and allocation strategy are PILOT_PLACEHOLDER values, not research conclusions.
protocol.label: pilot-placeholder
protocol._practice_order_comment: By default all practice tasks follow the participant-assigned order, then all experimental tasks repeat that order. A fixed practice order is available only as a configurable alternative; neither method is claimed to be optimal.
protocol._debug_comment: Non-experimental developer mode. This order never replaces a participant's stored counterbalanced assignment.

flick_task._comment: PLACEHOLDER values chosen only so the task can be tested. They are not research decisions. All sizes/distances are physical (device) pixels.
flick_task._stabilization_comment: PILOT_PLACEHOLDER: radius = start marker radius, movement threshold = movement_onset_threshold_px, duration chosen only for testing. Research decision required.

tracking_task._comment: PLACEHOLDER values chosen only so the task can be tested. Path: per axis centre + A/2 * sum(w_i * (sin(2*pi*f_i*t + phase_i) - sin(phase_i))); phases come from the seed.

switching_task._comment: PLACEHOLDER values chosen only so the task can be tested. One click per target; one stored trial row per target.

recommendation._comment: PLACEHOLDER rule set for rule-based candidate scoring. The components, weights, thresholds and rule rationales are unvalidated hypotheses chosen only so the pipeline can be tested. They must be reviewed before use in research.

rules.rationale: Placeholder hypothesis: Flick Aim clicks land far from the target centre, so favour crosshairs with a small gap and thin lines (a more precise centre reference).
Placeholder hypothesis: the crosshair is often off the moving target, so favour crosshairs that stand out more against the background (contrast, outline, opacity).
Placeholder hypothesis: targets are often missed while switching, so favour crosshairs that cover less of the target.
Placeholder hypothesis: frequent Flick Aim timeouts, so give extra weight to crosshair visibility.
